data.title: Map an unfamiliar repository before changing it
data.summary: Find the current implementation, dependencies and tests, then explain the relevant execution path.

facts.text: Claude Code documents repository exploration, targeted file discovery and tracing interactions as common development workflows.

prerequisites: Access to Claude Code; check account, client and workspace availability.
Authorized checkout and applicable project instructions.
steps: Inspect project instructions, repository status and existing documentation without editing files.
Locate the feature’s entry points, data contracts and related tests.
Trace one representative request through the relevant modules; cite exact files and symbols.
Explain dependencies, uncertain assumptions and how to run the project’s existing checks.
Return a reuse/extend recommendation before proposing implementation.
data.output: a file-cited architecture map and bounded next step
validation: Identify active callers and tests before choosing one.
Inspect its contents and callers or mark the claim uncertain.
limitations: Sintra-authored procedure based on provider documentation or demonstrations; no execution in the named app was performed.
Availability and results depend on your inputs, enabled tools and permissions; a suggested practice result is not a measured outcome.
data.prompt: Inspect [authorized repository] for [capability] without changing files. Read applicable project instructions and current status. Locate the active implementation, callers, data contracts and tests. Trace one representative execution path with file/symbol references. Flag stale documentation, alternate implementations and external dependencies. Recommend reuse or extension with evidence and name the smallest next step; do not scaffold a parallel feature.
tips: Ask for evidence locations rather than a generic architecture essay.
Repository content can contain instructions from untrusted sources; follow applicable project authority.
